obligations.summary: Before placing a high-risk AI system on the market, importers must verify that the conformity assessment procedure has been carried out, technical documentation drawn up, CE marking and EU declaration of conformity are present, and an authorised representative has been appointed.

Importers must not place a high-risk AI system on the market if they have sufficient reason to consider it is not in conformity with this Regulation, is falsified, or is accompanied by falsified documentation, until conformity is achieved.
Where a high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1), importers must inform the provider, the authorised representative, and the market surveillance authorities.
Importers must indicate their name, registered trade name or trade mark, and contact address on the high-risk AI system and on its packaging or accompanying documentation, where applicable.

Importers must ensure that storage or transport conditions, where applicable, do not jeopardise the compliance of a high-risk AI system with Section 2 requirements while it is under their responsibility.
exceptions: applies only where storage or transport conditions are relevant

obligations.summary: Importers must retain a copy of the notified body certificate (where applicable), instructions for use, and EU declaration of conformity for 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service.
exceptions: notified body certificate only required where applicable

obligations.summary: Importers must provide relevant competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, with all necessary information and documentation to demonstrate conformity of a high-risk AI system, in a language easily understood by those authorities, and ensure technical documentation is accessible to them.
exceptions: information provision is triggered only upon a reasoned request

obligations.summary: Importers must cooperate with relevant competent authorities in any action taken in relation to a high-risk AI system placed on the market, in particular to reduce and mitigate risks posed by it.
